queries.query: Find the catering preparation area inside the ballroom wing

queries.query: Find the dedicated exit passage at the edge of the ballroom
queries.acceptance_rule: traversal visits zone_ballroom and leaf_ballroom_egress, then selects v019
queries.notes: Root-connected egress leaf is verified.
